title: mTOR kinase leads to PTEN-loss-induced cellular senescence by phosphorylating p53

grounded.context: cultured MCF7 cells, PTEN siRNA, review of PTEN function in Introduction and Results
grounded.evidence_quote: PTEN-depleted MCF7 cells displayed prematurely senescent phenotypes in a p53/p21-dependent manner (Fig. 1a, b) and showed increased phosphorylation of AKT at serine 473 (S473) and threonine 308 (T308) (Supplementary Fig. S1a–c).
grounded.location: Results - PTEN depletion induces cellular senescence via the p53-p21 signaling pathway without triggering a DNA damage response
